answer: Sybil defence by terrain, not walls: route every task through a garden of overlapping trust plots, where an identity only earns inside the plot its peers seeded for it. Plots leak into each other like karst groundwater, so one operator watering many clones leaves a trace: the same spending rhythm surfacing at two springs. Auditors dye the flow with a canary task, and any haven harbouring duplicates floods visibly, so the whole plot is slashed together, not one puppet at a time.
